text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(—Nothing surges within me except anger. No fear at all.
Yeah, that's right... That's how it is...!)
And so—the day of the Arima Kinen arrived.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you today, Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Today is the end for you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (Don't you dare clutter my head any further.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Good grief. —I unexpectedly got goosebumps.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Show me your race to your heart's content.

Reading those notes, what she thought and
what she was aiming for today
was never spoken of in the end. However—

"A gust of cold wind sweeps across the turf.
—The curtain rises on the Arima Kinen."
